title: ...get into a minor fender bender car accident
desc: Keep a clear head, gather evidence, and protect yourself legally on the road.
todos: Move your vehicle safely out of traffic and turn on hazard flashers.
Check all passengers for injuries and call 911 immediately if required.
Photograph vehicle damage, street signs, license plates, and overall scene.
Exchange contact, insurance policy, and driver's license details with other driver.
Report the incident to your auto insurance provider and file a police report.
